services.desc: Let me mend and alter your favourite clothes so that they can work for you.  Check out my price list, come visit me at a happy hour, or get in touch to get all your questions answered.
In the style of our parents' tupperware parties, get your crew together and we'll fix some things! I'll demo some basic fixes (and, of course, tailor your clothes).  Learn more!
Are you crafty yourself but want to skip the boring stuff? I can finish and block your knitted and crochet garments and wind your skeins of yarn.  Check out the prices page for more.
Do you need a hand confronting your sewing machine?  I provide inexpensive cleanings and servicing then I'll show you how to make the most out of your machine.
I sew, knit and crochet, let's make your next trunk show or sewing pattern look good!  Contact me directly to get started.
